title: Swish Flick
description: Flick the ball up to shoot hoops! The way you flick aims the ball, and how fast you flick sets how far it flies. Beat the clock in Arcade, or play 24 crazy story shots from rooftops, a pirate ship, a candy valley and the Moon.
notes: Pseudo-3D canvas game: the ball is simulated in real 3D (metres, gravity, wind, moon gravity) with a fixed 240 Hz step and drawn through a perspective camera behind the shooter. The rim is a torus (front rim, back rim, roll-ins), the backboard and obstacles are oriented boxes (bank shots, walls, trampolines), and a basket only counts when the ball's centre passes down through the rim plane inside the rim (coming up from below cancels the shot). The flick's direction and speed come from the last ~100 ms of the swipe plus its length, with a gentle aim help near each level's best shot. The basket count is a 7-segment LED panel drawn in perspective on the backboard (made/needed in story, baskets + clock in arcade). Arcade: 60 s, fire after 3 in a row (double points), the hoop starts sliding at 10 baskets, faster at 20, up and down at 30. Story: 4 worlds x 6 levels in a data table (LEVELS), 1-3 stars by balls used, worlds unlock with stars, an optional dotted-arc hint after 3 misses. Leaderboard: BRB.score.submit(points, 'baskets') + BRB.gameOver({won:false, score}) at the end of arcade; story levels call BRB.gameOver({won: stars > 0}) only. Saves best score, stars per level, unlocked worlds, total baskets and the helper-arc setting in BRB.storage key 'swish-flick-v1' (ids only, no words). Speaks all 13 site languages (I18N table, BRB.user.lang, RTL menus for he/ar). Sound: BRB.sfx plus a small WebAudio synth (bounce, clank, board, swish, cheer) that respects BRB.sfx.muted. Built on the Oomba Kit 1.1.0 (pinned tag plus the art-animals, art-props and dress packs; no web fonts). The court stays the game's own perspective canvas drawn in the kit's Oomba Ink look: Ink outlines on near boxes, a kit-style ball, kit sticker text for shot calls (a new call replaces the last shot's, so two never overlap) and kit reward sparks. Kit art in each world: a cheering crowd of 13 kit characters waving pennants and a row of hazed park trees (arcade), cars, a bus and lanterns (city), boats (ship), candy canes, donuts, cupcakes, sweets and gifts (candy), a rocket, flag, rocks, a UFO and a satellite (space). The kit draws the title screen (no hero: the lockup at the top, the hoop in view, the game's menu card at the bottom of the court's frame, the oomba mark and corner buttons inside the frame), the pause screen with settings, and the result cards (no hero, a big orange score, the buttons side by side at one width); the story map and level card are the game's own DOM in the kit's sticker style with kit icons and world art. HUD balls are little SVG basketballs. Kit font and colours, light and dark, reduced motion from the kit's settings. window.__brbTest exposes state/start/flick/shoot/step/skipAnimations/levels/solve/setTime/seed/freeze/frameStats/camera.

en-GB.description: Flick the ball up to shoot hoops! The way you flick aims the ball, and how fast you flick sets how far it flies. Beat the clock in Arcade, or play 24 crazy story shots from rooftops, a pirate ship, a sweetie valley and the Moon.

pt.description: Deslize a bola para cima e acerte a cesta! O jeito que você desliza mira a bola, e a velocidade decide até onde ela vai. Corra contra o relógio no Arcade ou jogue 24 arremessos malucos na História: telhados, navio pirata, vale dos doces e a Lua.

fr.description: Glisse la balle vers le haut pour marquer des paniers ! Le sens de ton geste vise, et sa vitesse décide jusqu’où la balle vole. Bats le chrono en Arcade, ou joue 24 tirs fous en Histoire : toits, bateau pirate, vallée des bonbons et la Lune.

es.description: ¡Desliza la pelota hacia arriba para encestar! La dirección apunta y la rapidez decide hasta dónde vuela. Gánale al reloj en Arcade o juega 24 tiros locos en Historia: azoteas, un barco pirata, un valle de dulces y la Luna.

de.description: Wisch den Ball nach oben und triff den Korb! Die Richtung zielt, und wie schnell du wischst, bestimmt, wie weit er fliegt. Spiel gegen die Uhr in Arcade oder schaff 24 verrückte Würfe in der Geschichte: Dächer, Piratenschiff, Bonbontal und der Mond.

he.description: מחליקים את הכדור למעלה וקולעים לסל! הכיוון מכוון את הזריקה, והמהירות קובעת כמה רחוק הכדור יעוף. התחרו בשעון בארקייד, או שחקו 24 זריקות מטורפות בסיפור: גגות, ספינת פיראטים, עמק הממתקים והירח.

ja.description: ボールを上にはじいてシュート！はじく向きでねらい、はやさでとぶきょりがきまるよ。アーケードでタイムに挑戦するか、ストーリーで24のびっくりシュートにチャレンジしよう。やね、かいぞくせん、おかしのたに、そして月！
ja.tags: バスケットボール,バスケ,シュート,ゴール,スポーツ,アーケード,ストーリー,チャレンジ,かいぞく,うちゅう,おかし

ar.description: اسحب الكرة إلى الأعلى لتسجّل في السلة! اتجاه السحب يصوّب الكرة، وسرعته تحدّد إلى أي مدى تطير. تسابق مع الوقت في وضع آركيد، أو العب 24 رمية مجنونة في القصة: أسطح، سفينة قراصنة، وادي الحلوى والقمر.

ru.description: Смахни мяч вверх и попади в кольцо! Направление смахивания задаёт прицел, а скорость решает, как далеко полетит мяч. Успей до конца таймера в аркаде или пройди 24 безумных броска в истории: крыши, пиратский корабль, конфетная долина и Луна.

it.description: Scorri la palla verso l’alto e fai canestro! La direzione mira, e la velocità decide quanto lontano vola. Batti il tempo in Arcade o gioca 24 tiri pazzi nella Storia: tetti, nave pirata, valle dei dolci e la Luna.

zh-Hant.description: 把球往上滑就能投籃！滑的方向決定瞄準，滑的速度決定球飛多遠。在街機模式跟時間賽跑，或在故事模式挑戰 24 個瘋狂投籃：屋頂、海盜船、糖果山谷，還有月球！
zh-Hant.tags: 籃球,投籃,籃框,運動,街機,故事模式,挑戰,海盜,太空,糖果

nl.description: Veeg de bal omhoog en gooi raak! De richting bepaalt waar je mikt, en hoe snel je veegt bepaalt hoe ver de bal vliegt. Speel tegen de klok in Arcade of probeer 24 gekke worpen in het verhaal: daken, een piratenschip, een snoepvallei en de maan.
